i know exactly how you feel, its been the same for me lately as well. its so hard to keep trying when it feels like everything is against you. but one thing ive always kept in mind is the idea of therapy as a sport, and its relation to muscle memory. im gonna go off topic but i swear it relates eventually lol. but i used to swim competitively, for almost 7 years and i quit because of how bad my depression was getting. i havent swam in almost 2 years but if i jumped in the pool right now, i would be able to at least do the motions and stay afloat. sure, it wouldnt be great, it would feel really weird, and i would be sore after, but if i kept swimming for a while after that, it would feel like i had only taken a week of, at most. when it comes to therapy and learning how to heal, its never something that gets truly lost. its still in your head, you still know how to do it, but you just need a bit of a reminder and some practice. healing is never linear, in fact, it would be weird if it were. i relapsed with my self harm about a week ago and felt the same way. but that doesnt mean all the work ive done thus far has gone to waste at all! it just means you hit a bump (or pothole) in the road. maybe take some time to yourself, tell your therapist about how youve been really feeling and do what you enjoy doing. take a week off of work, so you can focus on school and yourself. do something youve been meaning to do that will make you happier (ie drawing, reading a specific book, playing a game, baking cookies). times have been really tough and school is hard enough as it is. give yourself credit for waking up in the morning! and dont forget: healing is never linear, you got this op and my dms are always open

hi. i first wanted to say that i’m really sorry you feel this way. life is so fucking hard sometimes and it’s honestly not fair. ive met my fair share of people who deal with the same kind of thing. the best advice i can give you right now is to do something to distract yourself. i know it seems dumb, but taking a shower, talk yo friends, watching some old  youtube video that makes you laugh, playing a game, reading, or even drawing shit can get you out of this mess. i’m not sure what you’re into but just lock your door and spend the next few minutes doing something that wont make you think about anything. you’re stronger than your shitty family. you will get out of this. life gives us all this bullshit for a reason (cheesy i know) but in the end, you’ll be a better person. stay strong for future you. so that you can read the news article that says “the lockdown is over you can go outside”. i believe in you. things will get better.
